{{Quote|This is Imperial Shuttle 995. Requesting permission to enter Desix airspace.|Imperial Shuttle 995 pilot|<ref name="Solitary" />}}
'''Imperial Shuttle 995''' was a [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]] that was sent on a [[Mission to Desix|mission]] to [[Desix]] to liberate [[Governor]] [[Grotton]] from the hands of Governor [[Tawni Ames]] and her [[Desix Separatist holdout|Separatist holdout]]. The [[shuttle]] was shot down by [[B1-series battle droid]]s when approaching the surface and crashed in [[Sector Five]] of the [[Farm]]lands. The [[Crosshair and Cody's team|survivors]] of the crash invaded the [[Desix City|city]] and were successful in extracting Grotton.

==Description==
[[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Shuttle]] 995 was a [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]]<ref name="Solitary" /> that was used as a multi-purpose [[transport]].<ref name="SWE" /> It was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]], which let it jump into [[hyperspace]],<ref name="Solitary" /> an alternate dimension that allowed traveling at [[lightspeed]].<ref name="DB hyperdrive">{{Databank|hyperdrive|Hyperdrive}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Imperial vessel has been neutralized and crashed in Sector Five.|Tactical Droid to Tawni Ames|<ref name="Solitary" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era]]<ref name="Solitary" /> between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Imperial Shuttle 995 was used as transportation by the Galactic Empire. [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] assigned [[Clone Commander]] [[Cody]], [[clone commando]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair," and a [[Crosshair and Cody's team|squad]] of [[clone trooper]]s on a [[Mission to Desix|mission]] to rescue [[Governor]] [[Grotton]] from the [[Desix Separatist holdout|Separatist holdout]] on the [[planet]] [[Desix]]. The [[Cloning|clones]] boarded the shuttle near the [[First Battle Memorial]] on the planet [[Coruscant]]. While in hyperspace, Cody explained to the [[squad]] that [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] insurgents seized the [[Desix City|city]] and took Grotton hostage. Crosshair added that the holdout's [[battle droid]]s could have been reprogrammed after the shutdown order. Cody told the squad that they would use their guise as a diplomatic envoy to catch the insurgents by surprise, wipe out the [[droid]]s, and locate [[Grotton]].<ref name="Solitary" />

[[File:Desix_sector_five.png|thumb|left|300px|B1 battle droids approaching the wreckage of Imperial Shuttle 995]]
After the shuttle exited hyperspace, the [[pilot]] requested permission to enter Desix [[Atmosphere|airspace]] and was permitted by a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Desix)|tactical droid]]. When the [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|tactical droid]] spotted the shuttle, they told Governor [[Tawni Ames]] that it was in range, and she ordered the droid to welcome them. The tactical droid ordered the [[Desix air strike team|strike team]] to move into position where they shot at the shuttle with [[RPS-6 rocket launcher]]s. One [[missile]] hit one of the shuttle's wings, causing massive damage. An [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I]] then shot at the shuttle, causing it to crash in [[Sector Five]] of the [[Farm]]lands, and around half of the squad was injured. On orders from the tactical droid, a small group of [[B1-series battle droid]]s checked the wreckage for survivors. The droids found [[Death|dead]] clone [[trooper]]s in the shuttle and reported no survivors before being quickly killed by the remaining troopers. The squad then proceeded to infiltrate the city and rescue Grotton.<ref name="Solitary" />

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial Shuttle 995 first appeared in "[[The Solitary Clone]]," the third episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' animated series,<ref name="Solitary" /> which aired on [[January 11]], [[2023]].<ref name="BB S2">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref>
